verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no explicit documentation of Linux driver releases (e.g., NVIDIA driver/CUDA Linux release notes) nor any independent Linux-specific benchmarking or testing report for the H200 SXM; CUDA Toolkit mentions are generic cross-platform docs without Linux specifics, and community posts (comm-1) describe an inference deployment without naming an OS. Since datacenter GPUs are commonly expected to have first-class Linux driver support and testing, this axis clearly applies but is unevidenced here.
